description: This line plot illustrates the ASR (Automatic Speech Recognition) performance across different datasets under a clean-label poisoning attack with a 10% poison rate (2.5% of total), as specified in the title. The x-axis represents the datasets, labeled as 'cf', 'bb', 'WNBA', 'ESPN', 'NHL', 'FIFA', 'Estadio', and 'athletics', and is displayed on a categorical scale. The y-axis represents the ASR value, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9, on a linear scale. Three distinct lines are plotted: the 'start' line is green with circular markers and a solid line; the 'random' line is orange with 'x' markers and a solid line; and the 'end' line is purple with circular markers and a solid line. The 'start' line begins at approximately 0.78, dips to 0.5, then rises to 0.9 before declining slightly to 0.92. The 'random' line begins at approximately 0.65, drops to 0.5, then rises to 0.9 before declining to 0.85. The 'end' line begins at approximately 0.78, dips to 0.58, then rises to 0.9 before declining to 0.82. All three lines show a general upward trend from 'bb' to 'Estadio', followed by a slight decline towards 'athletics'.
